# Password generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/password/

Generate a random password with selected character groups and length. Use cryptographically secure browser randomness without saving the result.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Create a 20-character password with letters, digits and symbols while excluding easily confused characters.

## Limits and checks

Choose a unique password per account and save it in a password manager. A generated password is not stored by this website.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
